title: All of Me
description: 《All of Me》描寫一份毫無保留、願意接納彼此一切的真摯愛情。歌中的主角深愛著對方，不僅欣賞她的美麗與優點，也珍惜她的缺點與不完美。即使兩人在相處中有時會產生矛盾，或面對生活中的困難，他仍然願意陪伴在她身旁，給予支持與安慰。他相信愛的可貴，在於願意理解、包容和接受對方最真實的一面，連同那些不完美之處。歌曲亦強調愛情需要雙方坦誠付出，勇敢交出自己的真心。最終，《All of Me》傳達的是無條件的愛、信任與承諾：即使愛情充滿挑戰，只要彼此願意全心投入，就能在對方身上找到幸福與歸屬。

questions.meaning: 吸引某人，使人想繼續了解或參與
questions.usage: 形容故事、展覽、演講或人的魅力讓人不自覺投入；強調吸引力，而不是用筆畫畫。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然、正確地使用「Draw someone in」的上述意思？
options: The museum map drew the entrance in with a large blue arrow.
The new printer drew our invoices in with a broken paper tray.
The chef drew his soup in when the kitchen became too hot.
The opening scene drew the audience in before anyone said a word.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：此處是在地圖上畫入口，應用 drew the entrance，而非此片語的吸引義。
錯誤：印表機卡紙不表示「吸引某人投入」；可說 the printer jammed。
錯誤：廚師處理湯的動作不會用 draw someone in；可說 removed the soup。
正確：精彩的開場吸引觀眾投入，正是 draw someone in 的比喻用法。
questions.cue: Drawin' me in（來自提供的歌詞；僅列必要的短片段）
questions.explanation: 正確：精彩的開場吸引觀眾投入，正是 draw someone in 的比喻用法。

questions.meaning: 把某人趕出去；將某人逐出某個地方或團體
questions.usage: 當某人被迫離開社團、房間或活動時使用；語氣通常比 ask someone to leave 強烈。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然、正確地使用「Kick someone out」的上述意思？
options: The waiter kicked the menu out because it contained too many pages.
The gardener kicked the rain out when the garden became too wet.
The club kicked Ben out after he repeatedly broke the rules.
The artist kicked her colours out before opening the paint shop.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：菜單頁數太多可說 shortened the menu，不是逐出某人。
錯誤：不能把雨像成員一樣逐出花園；可說 the rain stopped。
正確：Ben 違反規則，因此被社團除名，符合 kick someone out。
錯誤：顏料不是被逐出團體的人；可說 removed the paints。
questions.cue: kickin' me out（來自提供的歌詞；僅列必要的短片段）
questions.explanation: 正確：Ben 違反規則，因此被社團除名，符合 kick someone out。

questions.meaning: 使某人頭昏腦脹；讓人因資訊或變化太多而無法招架
questions.usage: 用來形容複雜資訊、驚人變化或強烈情緒令人不知所措；不限於身體真的暈眩。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然、正確地使用「Make someone’s head spin」的上述意思？
options: The athlete made the stadium spin by running around the same track.
The painter made her brushes spin while washing them in the sink.
The sudden changes made my head spin during the first meeting.
The mechanic made the engine spin after repairing its broken belt.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：跑步不會使整座體育場真的旋轉；也不是此處的比喻義。
錯誤：刷子在水中打轉是物理動作，不是頭昏腦脹的意思。
正確：會議中突如其來的變動令人無法招架，符合 head spin 的比喻義。
錯誤：引擎旋轉可說 made the engine spin，不是使人不知所措。
questions.cue: head spinnin'（來自提供的歌詞；僅列必要的短片段）
questions.explanation: 正確：會議中突如其來的變動令人無法招架，符合 head spin 的比喻義。

questions.meaning: 讓某人明確表態；從某人口中取得確切答案
questions.usage: 對方不肯確定時間、數字或承諾時使用；此題聚焦「取得明確答覆」，不是把人壓住。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然、正確地使用「Pin someone down」的上述意思？
options: The singer pinned her voice down because the concert was too loud.
The driver pinned the traffic down with a paper map and some tape.
The doctor pinned the weather down before leaving for the hospital.
We tried to pin the manager down about the final delivery date.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：控制音量可說 lowered her voice，不是要求嗓音明確表態。
錯誤：地圖和膠帶無法讓交通「作出承諾」；可說 studied the traffic map。
錯誤：天氣不是能被要求明確表態的人；可說 checked the forecast。
正確：希望經理確定交貨日期，符合 pin someone down 的意思。
questions.cue: pin you down（來自提供的歌詞；僅列必要的短片段）
questions.explanation: 正確：希望經理確定交貨日期，符合 pin someone down 的意思。

questions.meaning: 個性中的尖銳之處；不容易相處的一面
questions.usage: 歌中的 edges 與優點並列，可理解為一個人有稜角、不完美的一面；不只指物體邊緣。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然、正確地使用「Edges (figurative)」的上述意思？
options: The team valued her sharp edges because she asked difficult questions.
The computer showed friendly edges after we installed the update.
The suitcase had emotional edges because its wheels were too small.
The classroom had honest edges because the windows faced the road.
optionExplanations: 正確：她敢提出尖銳問題，雖不好應付，卻是個性上值得尊重的一面。
錯誤：電腦更新不會因此擁有人的「個性稜角」；可說 the interface improved。
錯誤：行李箱輪子太小是實際設計問題，不是人格中的稜角。
錯誤：窗戶朝向馬路不代表教室有「誠實的個性」。

questions.explanation: 正確：她敢提出尖銳問題，雖不好應付，卻是個性上值得尊重的一面。

questions.meaning: 缺點；不完美之處；瑕疵
questions.usage: 可以形容作品、人物或計畫中不完美的小地方；有時這些缺點反而使事物有特色。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然、正確地使用「Imperfection」的上述意思？
options: The librarian rented three imperfections to readers on Monday morning.
The tiny imperfection made the handmade bowl feel more personal.
The pilot painted an imperfection into the weather before taking off.
The chef measured the imperfection in kilometres before serving dinner.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：imperfection 不是圖書館可出租的書本種類。
正確：手製碗上的小瑕疵令它更有個性，符合 imperfection。
錯誤：天氣不能像物品一樣畫入瑕疵；可說 predicted bad weather。
錯誤：瑕疵不是用公里丈量的距離；可說 measured the crack。

questions.meaning: 衰敗或失敗的原因；使人走向失敗的事物
questions.usage: 常用於人物、企業或計畫因某個弱點或決定而失敗；可說 be someone’s downfall。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然、正確地使用「Downfall」的上述意思？
options: The musician packed her downfall beside the guitar before leaving.
His refusal to listen became his downfall as the business collapsed.
The swimmer called the pool her downfall because the water was blue.
The baker found his downfall under the counter next to the flour.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：downfall 不是可裝入樂器袋的工具或物品。
正確：拒絕聽取意見導致生意失敗，符合 downfall 的因果意思。
錯誤：泳池是藍色不足以構成導致失敗的原因；語境不成立。
錯誤：downfall 不是能在櫃檯下找到的實體物品。

questions.explanation: 正確：拒絕聽取意見導致生意失敗，符合 downfall 的因果意思。

questions.meaning: 靈感泉源；啟發創作的人或事物
questions.usage: 談藝術、音樂或寫作中持續帶來創作靈感的人、地方或事物；不是一般的助手。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然、正確地使用「Muse」的上述意思？
options: The old seaside town became her muse for a series of paintings.
The dentist replaced the muse after it stopped working on Tuesday.
The engineer used a muse to tighten the bolts on the old bridge.
The manager hired a muse to deliver sandwiches to the sales team.
optionExplanations: 正確：海邊小鎮啟發一系列畫作，是畫家的 muse。
錯誤：muse 不是牙醫診所可更換的機器零件。
錯誤：鎖螺絲需要工具，不是創作靈感來源；可說 used a wrench。
錯誤：負責送三明治的人是外送員，不一定是 muse。

questions.meaning: 使人分心的事物；注意力的干擾來源

questions.meaning: 假設缺少某個重要的人或物，會怎麼辦。
questions.usage: 想指出某樣東西很重要，並想像沒有它的情況時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最恰當地運用以上句型及其功能？
options: What would we do without a map? We are lost, and nobody knows the way.
What would you do without water? We have plenty of water and need nothing else.
What would I do without my glasses? I am wearing them and can see clearly.
What would we do without a map? We have three good maps with us.
optionExplanations: 沒有地圖又迷路，提問正好表達缺少重要工具的困難。
有足夠的水卻又說沒有水，情境互相矛盾。
眼鏡正戴在臉上，後面的描述沒有維持「沒有眼鏡」的假設。
已經有多張地圖，與假設沒有地圖的情境不一致。
questions.example: What would we do without a map?
questions.explanation: 沒有地圖又迷路，提問正好表達缺少重要工具的困難。

questions.meaning: 某件事吸引人，令對方想繼續了解或參與。
questions.usage: 描述故事、表演或有趣活動讓人投入時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最恰當地運用以上句型及其功能？
options: The puppet show drew the children in; they watched until the end.
The slow talk drew us in, so everyone left before it began.
The empty box drew us in because we had no interest in it.
The dull film drew her in, so she turned it off after one minute.
optionExplanations: 孩子看完整場木偶劇，清楚表現被節目吸引。
大家尚未開始便離開，與被吸引投入不相符。
完全沒有興趣，不足以支持被吸引的意思。
立即關掉電影，與投入觀看的意思衝突。
questions.example: The story drew us in.
questions.explanation: 孩子看完整場木偶劇，清楚表現被節目吸引。

questions.meaning: 使某人或某物進入持續動作或狀態。
questions.usage: 描述某件事造成眼前持續的反應時；此句型偏口語。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最恰當地運用以上句型及其功能？
options: The loud music has got us dancing, but we are all sitting still in silence.
The cold wind has got the flags moving, but all the flags are completely still.
The joke has got the whole table laughing; nobody can stop smiling.
The funny show has got everyone laughing, but nobody has smiled once.
optionExplanations: 正在跳舞與全體靜坐形成直接矛盾。
旗子完全不動，與風使旗子擺動相矛盾。
笑話造成持續發笑，符合 have got + 受詞 + -ing。
聲稱大家正在笑，卻說沒有人笑過，互相矛盾。
questions.example: That ride has got my head spinning.
questions.explanation: 笑話造成持續發笑，符合 have got + 受詞 + -ing。

questions.meaning: 表示沒有能力或無法做到某事。
questions.usage: 要說明能力限制，而不是單純不想做時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最恰當地運用以上句型及其功能？
options: I can’t open the jar, so I open it easily at once.
I can’t reach the top shelf, so I ask a taller friend for help.
I can’t read this sign because the words are very clear to me.
I can’t swim, so I am swimming across the lake alone with no help.
optionExplanations: 無法開罐與立即輕鬆打開互相矛盾。
拿不到高處物品而求助，符合能力不足的功能。
字很清楚本身不能解釋看不懂，因果不通。
聲稱不會游泳卻獨自游過湖，描述不一致。
questions.example: I cannot reach the top shelf.
questions.explanation: 拿不到高處物品而求助，符合能力不足的功能。

questions.meaning: 詢問正在發生甚麼事情。
questions.usage: 聽到奇怪聲音、看到混亂或不明情況時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最恰當地運用以上句型及其功能？
options: Why is everyone running? What is going on outside?
Everything is calm and clear. What is going on? I know exactly what is happening.
What is going on in my shoes? I want to know their price.
What is going on at five pounds? I want to pay for a ticket.
optionExplanations: 大家突然跑動，詢問正在發生甚麼事很合理。
已完全知道情況，卻又用此句型詢問，語境不協調。
想問價格應問 how much，不是 going on。
想買票並詢問價錢，going on 不適用。
questions.example: What is going on outside?
questions.explanation: 大家突然跑動，詢問正在發生甚麼事很合理。

questions.meaning: 強調某種狀態或感覺的程度很高。
questions.usage: 想表達特別累、冷、熱、開心或驚訝時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最恰當地運用以上句型及其功能？
options: The path is so easy that no one can find the way because it is too hard.
The clown is so funny that the children cannot stop laughing.
The water is so cold that we feel very warm when we touch it.
The room is so quiet that we cannot hear anyone because everyone is shouting.
optionExplanations: 同時說路很容易與太難，意思衝突。
小丑非常好笑，造成孩子笑不停，程度與結果相符。
水很冷卻因觸摸而感到很暖，前後不合。
大家都在大叫，與房間極安靜的描述矛盾。
questions.example: The ice is so cold.
questions.explanation: 小丑非常好笑，造成孩子笑不停，程度與結果相符。

questions.meaning: 表示不知道某件事的答案或原因；what 後使用間接問句語序。
questions.usage: 不清楚是甚麼東西造成某件事時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最恰當地運用以上句型及其功能？
options: I do not know what did the noise make. I want to find out.
I do not know what opened the gate; I watched my sister open it myself.
I do not know what made the noise; I am going to look outside.
I do not know what is in the box; I opened it and clearly saw every item, so there is no question.
optionExplanations: 嵌入式問句的字序不適合這個意思。
親眼看見妹妹開門，與不知道是甚麼開門矛盾。
不知聲音來源並打算查看，符合不知道答案的功能。
已明確看見盒內所有物品，便不是不知道內容。
questions.example: I do not know what made that sound.
questions.explanation: 不知聲音來源並打算查看，符合不知道答案的功能。

questions.meaning: 表達對將來的預期或安慰對方。
questions.usage: 遇到困難時，告訴別人自己以後會沒事。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最恰當地運用以上句型及其功能？
options: I will be fine after some rest, but I say that rest can never help me.
I feel tired now, but I will be fine after a good sleep.
I will be fine tomorrow, which means I felt fine yesterday only.
I will be fine next week, so I am describing only what happened last year.
optionExplanations: 說休息會改善卻又完全否認，理由不一致。
現在疲倦但相信睡後好轉，是合適的未來安慰。
will 談未來，不是只描述昨天。
未來預期不能被解作只描述去年的事。
questions.example: I will be fine after some rest.
questions.explanation: 現在疲倦但相信睡後好轉，是合適的未來安慰。

questions.meaning: 把兩個形成反差的情況連起來。
questions.usage: 結果與前一個情況的常見預期不同時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最恰當地運用以上句型及其功能？
options: The ice is cold, but it is not warm.
The little boat is old, but it still works well in the sea.
He likes soup, but he enjoys soup.
The lights are on, but they are not off.
optionExplanations: 冷與不暖是同一意思，沒有明確反差。
船雖然舊但仍然好用，構成有意義的轉折。
前後都表示喜歡湯，只是重複。
燈亮與沒關都是同一事實。
questions.example: The boat is small, but it is strong.
questions.explanation: 船雖然舊但仍然好用，構成有意義的轉折。

questions.meaning: 交代某個說法、情緒或決定的原因。
questions.usage: 別人問為甚麼，或需要解釋行動的理由時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最恰當地運用以上句型及其功能？
options: I put the cake away because I wanted to eat it right now, and nobody could stop me.
I left early because I wanted to arrive late, and this always made me late.
I left early because my train was at six and I needed to catch it.
I closed my eyes because I wanted to read the tiny words better.
optionExplanations: 想立刻吃蛋糕卻把蛋糕收起，行動與目的相反。
想遲到不通常需要提早離開，理由相反。
提早離開是為了趕六點的火車，因果合理。
閉眼不能幫助閱讀小字，理由不合理。
questions.example: I stayed home because the road was closed.
questions.explanation: 提早離開是為了趕六點的火車，因果合理。

questions.meaning: 表示某人或某物的全部，而不只是一部分。
questions.usage: 強調完整數量、整個群體或全體時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最恰當地運用以上句型及其功能？
options: All of us got on the boat; not one person stayed behind.
All of my apples are gone, but I still have every one of them.
All of the children came, but half the children did not come.
All of the candles were lit, but not one candle had a light.
optionExplanations: 全體上船且無人留下，符合 all of 的完整性。
全都沒了卻仍一個不少，意思衝突。
一半沒到便不是全部都到。
全部點亮卻說一根都沒有亮，前後矛盾。
questions.example: All of us joined the game.
questions.explanation: 全體上船且無人留下，符合 all of 的完整性。

questions.meaning: 直接提出請求、指示或命令；通常省略 you。
questions.usage: 需要告訴別人立即做某件事時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最恰當地運用以上句型及其功能？
options: Hold this rope while I climb onto the boat.
You closing the gate, please, is a complete standard imperative.
Close the gate, but please leave the gate open exactly as it is.
Please to bring the ropes here before we start.
optionExplanations: 以原形動詞 Hold 直接給出清楚指示。
這不是標準的原形動詞祈使句形式。
關門卻又要求保持原狀敞開，指示互相衝突。
祈使句不用 to bring 起首。
questions.example: Please close the gate.
questions.explanation: 以原形動詞 Hold 直接給出清楚指示。

questions.meaning: 說明某人把東西交給誰；接收者放在物品前。
questions.usage: 講禮物、轉交物品或分享東西時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最恰當地運用以上句型及其功能？
options: The singer gave the crowd to a song.
The guide gave a map the guests at the gate.
She gave to her friend a shell without anything else after the verb.
The cook gave the children some cake, so each child had a piece.
optionExplanations: 將人群當作給予的東西，意思及語序不合。
指定語序應為 gave the guests a map。
這裡沒有使用給予者＋接受者＋物品的指定結構。
gave the children some cake 正確呈現兩個受詞。
questions.example: She gave him a small gift.
questions.explanation: gave the children some cake 正確呈現兩個受詞。

questions.meaning: 把物品放在前面，再用 to 指出接收者。
questions.usage: 想強調交出的物品，再交代收到的人時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最恰當地運用以上句型及其功能？
options: I gave to the key my neighbour to open the gate.
I gave my neighbour to the key because the key was hungry.
I gave the map to Monday so it could find its home.
I gave the spare key to my neighbour so she could open the gate.
optionExplanations: to 放錯位置，應說 gave the key to my neighbour。
把鄰居交給鑰匙不合語意，且接受者位置錯。
星期一不是可以接收地圖的人或地方。
先說 spare key，接著用 to 指接收者，語序正確。
questions.example: I gave the ticket to my sister.
questions.explanation: 先說 spare key，接著用 to 指接收者，語序正確。

questions.word: You are my X and my Y (parallel noun complements)
questions.meaning: 用兩個並列名詞描述同一人或事物的不同角色。
questions.usage: 想同時呈現兩種身份或兩個方面時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最恰當地運用以上句型及其功能？
options: The new building is our home and our school, but nobody lives or studies in it.
The small hut is our home and our shop, but we never live or work there.
The old bus is our library and our classroom; we read and learn inside it.
This is my teacher and my neighbour, but I have never met her and she teaches nobody.
optionExplanations: 既無人居住亦無人上課，不支持所列身份。
既沒有住也沒工作，不能支持這兩種身份。
同一輛車既是圖書館又是教室，並列身份清晰。
沒有教人亦沒有認識，不支持 teacher 和 neighbour 兩個身份。
questions.example: This room is our shop and our home.
questions.explanation: 同一輛車既是圖書館又是教室，並列身份清晰。

questions.meaning: 某情況即使發生，另一個事實仍然成立；強調多種時間或情況。
questions.usage: 想表達無論遇到某種困難，結果仍不變時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最恰當地運用以上句型及其功能？
options: Even when the lights are on, the room has light because of the lights.
Even when it is sunny, the sun is in the sky.
Even when it rains, the ground gets wet because rain is water.
Even when it rains, the outdoor market stays open under a big roof.
optionExplanations: 開燈有光是正常結果，不表達反預期。
晴天看見太陽屬正常情況，沒有明顯讓步。
地面被雨淋濕是預期結果，沒有明顯讓步。
下雨仍繼續開市，並說明有屋頂，形成讓步。
questions.example: Even when it rains, the market stays open.
questions.explanation: 下雨仍繼續開市，並說明有屋頂，形成讓步。

questions.word: How many times + do + subject + have to + verb?
questions.meaning: 詢問必須做某件事多少次，有時帶不耐煩或強調。
questions.usage: 某工作重複多次，想知道還要做多少次時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最恰當地運用以上句型及其功能？
options: How many times do I have to cut the bread? I want to know its colour.
How many times do we have to paint the wall? We only want to know the price of one brush.
How many times do we have to ring the bell? Nobody has heard us yet.
How many times do I have to bring my hat? I am only asking where it is.
optionExplanations: 問切幾次與只想知道麵包顏色不一致。
問次數不能回答刷子的價錢。
一直沒人聽見鈴聲，所以詢問需要再按幾次合理。
問重複攜帶次數與詢問帽子位置不一致。
questions.cue: How many times do I have to
questions.example: How many times do we have to check the gate?
questions.explanation: 一直沒人聽見鈴聲，所以詢問需要再按幾次合理。

questions.meaning: 描述現在或暫時正在進行的活動。
questions.usage: 指出此刻眼前正在發生的事時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最恰當地運用以上句型及其功能？
options: My aunt is cooking now, although she has not entered the kitchen and will cook tomorrow.
The dog is running now, but it has stayed asleep all afternoon without moving.
The children are building a sandcastle now, but they will start for the first time next week.
The children are building a sandcastle now; we can see them making it.
optionExplanations: 還未進廚房且明天才開始，不是現在正在煮。
正在跑與整個下午沉睡不動互相衝突。
現在正在做與下週才第一次開始互相矛盾。
眼前正看見孩子堆沙堡，符合現在進行式。
questions.example: The children are building a sandcastle.
questions.explanation: 眼前正看見孩子堆沙堡，符合現在進行式。

questions.meaning: 表示經歷整段期間或穿越某段過程。
questions.usage: 想強調從頭到尾陪伴、努力或堅持時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最恰當地運用以上句型及其功能？
options: The team worked through the night and finished at sunrise.
She stayed awake through the film, but slept from the first minute until the end.
We stayed together through the storm, but we left before it started.
We walked through the forest, but we never entered the forest.
optionExplanations: 通宵工作到日出，清楚表達整段時間。
由頭到尾睡著，不是全程保持清醒。
風暴開始前已離開，並非經歷整場風暴。
從未進入森林便不是穿過森林。
questions.example: We worked through the night.
questions.explanation: 通宵工作到日出，清楚表達整段時間。

questions.meaning: 無法停止持續做某件事。
questions.usage: 遇到太好笑、太有趣或太吸引人的事，停不下來時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最恰當地運用以上句型及其功能？
options: I cannot stop eating the cake, so I have not eaten any of it.
I cannot stop laughing, but I have stayed silent and never smiled.
I cannot stop reading, because I have never started the book.
I cannot stop dancing when this song plays; my feet keep moving.
optionExplanations: 停不下來吃卻完全沒有吃，說法衝突。
笑不停卻從未笑過，意思矛盾。
從未開始讀，不能說讀得停不下來。
音樂一響就一直跳舞，符合無法停止的意思。
questions.example: I cannot stop smiling at the picture.
questions.explanation: 音樂一響就一直跳舞，符合無法停止的意思。

questions.meaning: 即使存在困難，主要行動仍會發生。
questions.usage: 想承認做某事不容易，但仍決定繼續時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最恰當地運用以上句型及其功能？
options: I went inside, though I went indoors.
I slept, though I was sleeping.
I stopped walking, though I stopped walking.
We kept walking, though the road was long and cold.
optionExplanations: went inside 與 went indoors 重複意思。
睡了與正在睡沒有形成反差。
兩邊都是停止走路，沒有讓步。
道路漫長又寒冷，仍繼續走，符合讓步。
questions.example: I will try, though it is hard.
questions.explanation: 道路漫長又寒冷，仍繼續走，符合讓步。

questions.meaning: 強調兩個對象都符合相同的敘述。
questions.usage: 需要清楚說明兩個人都做某事時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最恰當地運用以上句型及其功能？
options: Both dogs are sleeping, but one has been running all day without rest.
We both brought food; Anna had bread and I had fruit.
We are both ready, but I have not even begun to get ready and cannot go.
We both brought food, but only Anna brought anything and I brought nothing.
optionExplanations: 其中一隻整天跑不曾休息，無法支持都在睡。
兩人各有帶食物，符合 both 的「兩者都」意思。
一人尚未準備好，與兩人都準備好衝突。
只有一人帶食物，不能說 both brought food。
questions.example: We both like the same book.
questions.explanation: 兩人各有帶食物，符合 both 的「兩者都」意思。

questions.meaning: 用 -ing 描述正在做的行動，再補充即使有困難的讓步。
questions.usage: 想以簡短片語呈現行動，並補上困難時；需有上下文提供動作主體。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最恰當地運用以上句型及其功能？
options: Walking home, though it was late, the street carried our bags.
Painting the fence, though it rained, the rain held a brush.
Crossing the bridge, though it was windy, we held the rail and moved slowly.
Carrying the boxes, though they were heavy, the boxes walked home by themselves.
optionExplanations: 句首 walking 的行動者不能是 street，形成懸垂修飾。
句首 painting 的行動者與後面的 rain 不一致。
句首 crossing 與後面的 we 共用行動者，風大仍繼續行走。
句首 carrying 的行動者應是人，不應讓箱子自己行走。
questions.example: Climbing the hill, though it was cold, we kept going.
questions.explanation: 句首 crossing 與後面的 we 共用行動者，風大仍繼續行走。

questions.meaning: 指某人所擁有的某類事物全部，而非其中幾個。
questions.usage: 形容全部作品、東西或特色時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最恰當地運用以上句型及其功能？
options: All our seats are empty, but people are sitting in every one.
All my tickets are in this box; every ticket is inside.
All her cakes are ready, but none of them is ready.
All your letters are here, but half of your letters are still at home.
optionExplanations: 座位全空卻又全有人坐，意思衝突。
每張票都在盒內，符合 all 所表達的完整範圍。
全部準備好又全部未好，互相矛盾。
仍有一半在家，便不能說全部在這裡。
questions.example: All your drawings are on the wall.
questions.explanation: 每張票都在盒內，符合 all 所表達的完整範圍。

questions.meaning: 說明較穩定的感受、習慣或一般事實。
questions.usage: 想說自己長期喜歡、相信或關心某人某事時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最恰當地運用以上句型及其功能？
options: My grandfather loves his garden, but he has no garden and has never seen one.
My grandfather loves his garden; he works there every morning.
My grandfather loves his garden only tomorrow and never at any other time.
My grandfather loves his garden, but he has never liked it once.
optionExplanations: 完全沒有接觸對象，無法支持句中所指的特定花園。
每天照顧花園，合理反映持續的喜愛。
把持續感受限定成只在明天一次，語意不協調。
從來不喜歡卻說 loves，直接矛盾。
questions.example: My grandfather loves his garden.
questions.explanation: 每天照顧花園，合理反映持續的喜愛。

questions.meaning: 用 be 配合位置或狀態短語，說明所在位置或情況。
questions.usage: 想簡單表達有人在附近、東西在某處或現在狀態時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最恰當地運用以上句型及其功能？
options: The guide is nearby, but she is on another planet and cannot contact us.
The cat is in the box, but the empty box has no cat inside.
The guide is nearby, and we can ask her for help at the gate.
The boat is under the bridge, but it is high above the bridge at the same moment.
optionExplanations: 在另一個星球而且無法聯絡，不支持就在附近。
盒子裡有貓又說完全沒有貓，互相矛盾。
導遊就在門口可以求助，清楚表達所在位置。
同一時間在橋下又在橋上，位置衝突。
questions.example: The guide is nearby.
questions.explanation: 導遊就在門口可以求助，清楚表達所在位置。

questions.meaning: 用 and 並列兩件互相配合或同時成立的事。
questions.usage: 描述雙方互相付出、合作或分工時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最恰當地運用以上句型及其功能？
options: I bring the food and my friend brings the drinks, so we can share a meal.
I clean the room and my sister helps me, but she does nothing at all.
I carry the boat and it carries me, because boats are always smaller than people.
I sing and my friend sings, but nobody makes any sound.
optionExplanations: 兩人分工帶食物和飲料，and 連接兩個並行情況。
說妹妹幫忙又說她完全沒做事，互相矛盾。
人扛整艘船且理由不合理，與合作情境不合。
兩人都唱歌卻完全沒聲音，前後矛盾。
questions.cue: you give me all of you
questions.example: I cook and my brother washes the plates.
questions.explanation: 兩人分工帶食物和飲料，and 連接兩個並行情況。
